steps.python:
v = ${stats}
assert v['view_mode'] == 'lit' and v['viewport']['width'] > 0 and v['viewport']['height'] > 0, v

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, r'${scenario_dir}')
import view_checks as vc
for m in ['lit', 'unlit', 'normals', 'material', 'wireframe']:
    assert app.actions.run('view.mode', mode=m) == {'mode': m}
    vc.shot(app, m, r'${out}')
app.actions.run('view.mode', mode='lit')
# Lit draws a sky, so the geometry is what the normals view draws over its flat background.
bg = vc.background('normals')
fg = vc.foreground('normals', bg)
d = {m: vc.changed('lit', m, fg) for m in ['unlit', 'normals', 'material', 'wireframe']}
n = vc.unit_normals('normals', fg), vc.unit_normals('lit', fg)
w = len(vc.foreground('wireframe', bg)) / len(fg)
print('VIEW modes', d, 'normals', n, 'wire', w, 'background', bg, len(fg))
assert d['unlit'] > 0.1 and all(d[m] > 0.3 for m in ['normals', 'material', 'wireframe']), d
assert n[0] > 0.5 and n[0] > n[1] + 0.2, n
assert w < 0.6, w

c = [a for a in app.actions.list() if a['id'] == 'view.contacts'][0]
assert c['checked'], c

c = [a for a in app.actions.list() if a['id'] == 'view.contacts'][0]
assert not c['checked'], c

import view_checks as vc
vc.shot(app, 'none', r'${out}')

import view_checks as vc
vc.shot(app, 'one', r'${out}')
f = vc.near('none', vc.OUTLINE, 14), vc.near('one', vc.OUTLINE, 14)
print('VIEW outline', f)
assert f[1] > f[0] + 0.001, f

s = ${small}
assert s['path'] == '${p0.path}' and len(s['selection']) <= len(${added}['selection']), s
